title: Until 2019, 95% of PRIDE submissions were time-stamped 08–17 UTC, wherever they came from
sub:
Submission timestamp of 35,946 of 36,249 datasets (the rest carry no time of day), as stored (UTC). From about 2020 the stamps follow the
depositors' own working day (52% within 08–17 UTC in 2025). What the stamp records is not documented; weekday patterns in pre-2020
submission dates describe this single clock, not depositors.
